settings.heading: Why We Offer a 10 Days Risk-Free Hearing Aid Trial?
settings.text: Choosing a hearing aid is not a small purchase — it is a life decision that affects communication, confidence, relationships, and long-term health.

settings.title: Free Hearing Assessment
settings.text: Visit our clinic for a comprehensive, no-obligation hearing evaluation by our certified audiologists.

settings.title: 10-Day Home Trial
settings.text: Take your personally fitted hearing aids home and experience them in your daily life — completely risk-free.

settings.title: Love It or Return It
settings.text: If you're not thrilled with the results, simply return the devices. No questions asked, no charges applied.

settings.heading: 3 Simple Steps to Better Hearing
settings.subheading: We've made the process as easy and stress-free as possible

settings.title: Because Hearing Is Personal — You Need Time to Truly Feel the Difference
settings.description:
Every person's hearing is different. Every lifestyle is different. Every hearing loss is unique — and you cannot judge comfort or clarity from a quick test in a quiet room.
You need real conversations and real environments. Research shows 83% of long-term hearing aid users report higher satisfaction after real-world use.

settings.title: Because Your Brain Needs Time to Adjust to Clearer Sound
settings.description: Hearing loss develops slowly, so your brain adapts to muffled sound over years. When hearing aids restore clarity, your brain needs time to:
settings.points:
interpret speech details
adapt to everyday sounds
reduce listening effort
feel natural with clearer audio
settings.description_2: Most new users need 2–4 weeks to adapt comfortably. The 10-day trial gives your brain a realistic start.

settings.title: Because You Should Feel the Real Benefit Before You Commit
settings.description: The trial allows you to experience improvements in:
settings.points:
communication
confidence
relationships
mood and energy
daily activities
settings.description_2: Research shows 91% of users report better quality of life, and over 70% report easier communication after using hearing aids.

settings.title: Because We Don’t Believe in Hard Selling — We Believe in Helping
settings.points:
No pressure
No obligation
No risk
No hidden fees
settings.description_2: Hearing care should be honest, supportive, and centered around your well-being — never sales-driven.

settings.title: Because Hearing Aids Should Be Worn — Not Left in a Drawer
settings.description: A hearing aid only helps when it becomes part of your daily life.
settings.description_2: People who start with a trial are 3× more likely to wear their hearing aids consistently because they’ve seen the real benefit.

settings.title: Because We Want You to Make a Confident, Happy, Informed Decision
settings.description: Trying hearing aids in real life helps you understand:
settings.points:
Are conversations easier?
Do you feel less tired from listening?
Do you interact more confidently?
Does life feel more connected?

settings.title: Because You Deserve the Freedom to Try Before You Buy
settings.description: You test-drive a car before buying it. Hearing aids are even more personal — you deserve time and freedom to test them properly.

settings.a: This program allows you to try your chosen hearing aids for 10 full days in your everyday environment — at home, work, or in noisy places. If the hearing aids do not help, you have no obligation to buy.
